candidate_windows.window_text:
To ensure reproducibility, we describe details of our models and training procedure in the following.

Hyperparameters. We use hidden sizes of 256 units per direction for all BiLSTMs. The attention layer has a hidden size $H$ of 10. We set the mapping size $E$ to the size of the largest embedding in all experiments, i.e., 1024 dimensions, the size of XLM-R embeddings. The discriminator $D$ has a hidden size of 1024 units and is trained every $10^{th}$ batch. We perform a hyperparameter search for the $\lambda$ parameter in {1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6, 1e-7} for models using adversarial training. Note that we use the same hyperparameters for all models and all tasks.

Training. We use the AdamW optimizer with an initial learning rate of 5e-6. We train the models for a maximum of 100 epochs and select the best model according to the performance using the task's metric on the development set if available, or using the training loss otherwise. The training was performed on Nvidia Tesla V100 GPUs with 32GB VRAM. $^{3}$
